summary: Baker County lookout: a platform on the roof of a Forest Service carpenter shop in Baker City, gone by 1970. No source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Build date is unresolved: the register says 1948; firelookout.com says the 1930s; Forest Lookouts has panorama photographs from October 20, 1935. The story reports the disagreement without choosing. Thin source base: three pages, none with an account of the site today, ownership change or public access. The Forest Fire Lookout Association county list (https://firelookout.org/lookouts/us/or/or-co/) also marks it Rooftop and Gone, but we did not cite it. The one web search surfaced the Baker County Library photo archive, which we did not open. The record's 1066.8 m elevation matches the register's 3,500 ft.
